notes.s: Decision after t, used at t+1; 0 exploit, 1 explore.
notes.mode_used: Profile that generated iteration t; used for shading.
notes.X: Monitor-filtered window; NaN while warming up after each reset.
notes.parameters: a, F, CR used at t; G3 is not plotted.
notes.intensity: Continuous policies: intensity of the blended profile used at t (0 exploit, 1 explore). NaN for binary policies.
notes.window_selection: Rising exploit window with total rise closest to its ramp (fallback any rising); midpoint of longest flat explore run (fallback any flat). Missing categories omitted.
